gaps: No new-building permit appears in DOB data. DOB’s searchable job records for this building begin in 1990; older permits (including the original construction permit) survive only as scanned papers in DOB’s Building Information System and the Municipal Archives.
Online property records (ACRIS) for this lot start in 1971. ACRIS indexes Manhattan documents back to 1966; older deeds are on microfilm at the City Register.
Past occupants and businesses: no open city dataset lists them. City directories (NYPL) and newspapers are the likely sources; not yet automated.

sentences.text: Empire State Building stands at 350 Fifth Avenue, Manhattan.
City records also list it as 338 Fifth Avenue, 336 Fifth Avenue and 338-50 Fifth Avenue.
It was built in 1929–1931, designed by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon [William Lamb], for John J. Raskob (General Motors).
Its survey record lists style “Art Deco, Modernist”, materials “Brick, Indiana Limestone, Granite, Cast Stone, Metal” and original use “Commercial, offices”.
On May 19, 1981, the Landmarks Preservation Commission designated it a New York City Interior Landmark.
On May 19, 1981, the Landmarks Preservation Commission designated it a New York City Individual Landmark.

Wikidata also records these listings: New York State Register of Historic Places (September 27, 1982), National Register of Historic Places (November 17, 1982) and National Historic Landmark (June 25, 1986).

Wikidata records these events: groundbreaking ceremony (January 22, 1930), construction began (March 17, 1930), opening ceremony (May 1, 1931) and aviation accident (July 28, 1945). These are leads to verify, not official records.
Department of Buildings data from 1990 onward holds 2,610 job filings, 691 DOB violations, 241 ECB violations and 141 complaints for this building.
Of these, 8 are major alterations (changes of use, egress or occupancy); the most recent was filed January 18, 2011.
The city tax roll lists ESRT EMPIRE STATE BUILDING, L.L.C. as the current owner of record.
ACRIS holds 15 deeds, leases or other conveyances for the lot; the most recent deed, dated October 7, 2013, went to Esrt Empire State Building, L.L.C.
